components.name: Primary Action
components.description: The single prominent action in a region.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 999px; padding: .9rem 1.35rem; background: #376d7b; color: #fff; font: 600 1rem/1.2 sans-serif; transition: transform 260ms ease, background 260ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); background: #2b5d69; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #f0a77a; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Action
components.description: A quiet adjacent action that does not compete with the primary path.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { border: 1px solid rgba(31, 51, 69, .14); border-radius: 999px; padding: .9rem 1.35rem; background: transparent; color: #18212b; font: 500 1rem/1.2 sans-serif; transition: border-color 260ms ease, color 260ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #376d7b; color: #376d7b; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #f0a77a; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: A paper-like field with explicit focus rather than glass depth.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: .45rem; color: rgba(24, 33, 43, .68); font: 500 .82rem/1.4 sans-serif; } .ds-field input { min-height: 48px; border: 1px solid rgba(31, 51, 69, .14); border-radius: 12px; padding: .75rem .9rem; background: #fff; color: #18212b; font: 400 1rem/1.5 sans-serif; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(55, 109, 123, .28); border-color: #376d7b; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Navigation Link
components.description: Compact route navigation with a quiet active underline.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { display: inline-flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; color: rgba(24, 33, 43, .68); font: 500 .92rem/1.2 sans-serif; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link.is-active { color: #18212b; border-bottom-color: #376d7b; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #f0a77a; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Editorial Post Row
components.description: Chronological content grouped by spacing and a fine rule instead of a floating card.
components.html:
2026.08.02

把复杂的事写清楚

components.css: .ds-post-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 8rem 1fr; gap: .5rem 1.5rem; padding: 1.5rem 0; border-top: 1px solid rgba(31, 51, 69, .1); color: #18212b; } .ds-post-row time { color: rgba(24, 33, 43, .6); font: 500 .78rem/1.5 sans-serif; letter-spacing: .08em; } .ds-post-row h3 { margin: 0; font: 700 1.32rem/1.15 serif; } .ds-post-row p { grid-column: 2; margin: .35rem 0 0; color: rgba(24, 33, 43, .68); font: 400 1rem/1.65 sans-serif; }

narrative.northStar: 灯下研究手记 / The Illuminated Field Notebook
narrative.overview: The blog should feel like opening one coherent notebook whose pages contain research, learning, and ordinary life at different scales. The cinematic opening is the moment a lamp is lit; the publication that follows is the quiet desk beneath that light. Identity comes from editorial composition, typographic rhythm, fine rules, marginal notes, and selective warmth rather than stacked translucent cards.
keyCharacteristics: Reading-first editorial hierarchy with restrained asymmetry.
Cool paper, dark ink, patinated teal, and rare lantern warmth.
Fine rules and spacing establish groups before containers do.
Motion explains entry, continuity, and state.

rules.name: The One Lamp Rule
rules.body: Lantern warmth should occupy less than ten percent of a normal reading viewport. Its rarity gives it meaning.

rules.name: The Paper Before Glass Rule
rules.body: Reading surfaces are opaque or nearly opaque. Glass is reserved for transient controls, the opening, and the compact music player.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Serif speaks for authorship and reflection; sans-serif speaks for navigation, evidence, and operation.

rules.name: The Progressive Ledger Rule
rules.body: Check-in records and calendar come first; goals, totals, and analysis unfold on demand rather than appearing simultaneously.

dos: Do preserve the 点亮每一盏灯 opening as the strongest experiential signature.
Do use typography, whitespace, and fine rules to create hierarchy before adding a container.
Do test every change in light/dark, Chinese/English, desktop/mobile, reduced motion, and keyboard navigation.
donts: Don't make every page from interchangeable grids of translucent rounded cards.
Don't expose author-only CMS actions as public visitor actions.
Don't use progress bars and ratios as the dominant emotional expression of daily life.
